Settled: TRIAGE is a branch inside ONE function, not a fork between two. The routes diverge
at grounding (4), stay apart through output (6), and rejoin at acceptance (7) — shared
machinery, route-specific checklist. Both hand off to the same place.
Two things this stage still owes: the route-specific acceptance checklists are named but not
written, and neither document has a declared home or naming rule — that is blocked on the
cross-cutting "Where the work is written down", which is still drafted and unagreed.
